description: RAVEN_NEARBY_LINK_V1 §6. The receiver has the given role on a pipe that just came UP (no channel open; the central owns channel 0, the peripheral channel 1; W0 = 8 credits each way of a new channel instance; at most 64 outstanding) and frames are at most max_rx bytes. It applies the frames in order: every frame before fails_at is accepted, frame fails_at is refused with the error, and the receiver sends reset_hex; the pipe is then dead
name: RNP1 negative: an unknown kind (0x14)
